member.name: T:JordiAragonZaragoza.SharedKernel.Application.Attributes.AuthorizeAttribute
member.summary:
Specifies the class this attribute is applied to requires authorization.
Same model as ASP.NET Core: every attribute is a requirement and ALL the attributes applied to a class must be satisfied (AND). Inside one attribute: the user must hold ANY of the listed roles (OR), ALL the listed permissions and ALL the listed policies must pass; roles, permissions and policies of the same attribute are also cumulative.
To require several roles at once, apply several attributes ([Authorize(Roles = "A")] [Authorize(Roles = "B")]). For any other "this OR that" rule (permissions, ownership...) use a policy.

member.name: P:JordiAragonZaragoza.SharedKernel.Application.Attributes.AuthorizeAttribute.Roles

member.name: P:JordiAragonZaragoza.SharedKernel.Application.Attributes.AuthorizeAttribute.Policies

member.name: P:JordiAragonZaragoza.SharedKernel.Application.Attributes.AuthorizeAttribute.Permissions
